instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces. Place in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment; set aside to soften.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add hazelnuts and toast, stirring frequently, until golden and fragrant, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
Wash and dry cranberries (if using frozen, skip this step). Place in a large pot.

Wash, dry, zest, and juice orange into the pot with the cranberries. Add sugar and stir to combine. Set pot over medium-high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, cook, stirring occasionally, until cranberries completely burst and release their juices, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, add raspberry jam and vanilla to the pot, then mash with a potato masher until filling is smooth and combined. Let cool completely, about 45 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ orange
1 cup granulated sugar
1 cup raspberry jam, seedless
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray, then line the bottom and sides with parchment paper so that it overhangs the edges by 2 inches on both ends. Spray paper with more cooking spray. Set aside.
Transfer toasted hazelnuts to a food processor. Pulse several times until nuts are finely chopped. Set aside.
Beat the softened butter on medium-high speed until light and creamy, 2-3 minutes. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.
Add sugar to the bowl. Continue beating on medium speed until the butter mixture is light in color and fluffy in texture, 3-5 minutes more. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl.
Add flour and spices to the bowl. Mix on low speed until a rough dough forms.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ⅔ cups all-purpose flour
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add hazelnuts to the bowl. Mix on low speed until just combined.
Transfer 1 cup of the dough to a small bowl and set aside. Press remaining dough into base of the prepared baking dish in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the preheated oven and bake until golden and just set on top, 30-40 minutes. Remove tart base from oven and let cool slightly, 10 minutes.
After cooling, spoon filling into the baking dish and spread evenly over the base. Using your fingers, crumble reserved dough over the filling.
Return baking dish to the oven and continue to bake until topping is golden and filling is just set at the edges, 30-40 minutes more.
Remove from oven and set baking dish on a cooling rack. Let cool completely, 1 hour.
Using the overhanging parchment paper, carefully lift the tart out of the dish. Cut into slices, share, and enjoy!
